**Finding submitted: deviation (critical) on Section 20 (p0080).**

- **Issue:** The only indemnity in the Agreement runs against us — Customer indemnifies Vendor for "every claim" relating to our use of the Services, uncapped and not limited to third-party claims. No Vendor indemnity exists anywhere (confirmed by full-document searches; Sections 19.4, 21.3 and 30.5 only assume indemnities exist), and Section 9.3 cross-references a non-existent Section 20.5 remedy.
- **Classification:** Fails both the preferred and fallback positions and sits in walk-away territory (no Vendor IP indemnity plus a one-way Customer indemnity for Vendor's services).
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** Vendor IP/breach-of-law/data-breach/wilful-misconduct indemnity at 20.1; our indemnity narrowed to Customer-provided content and our breach of law at 20.2; standard notice/control/cooperation procedure at 20.3; customary IP exclusions at 20.4; and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies at 20.5 to cure the dangling Section 9.3 cross-reference.
